rows.q: What is high blood pressure?
rows.text: High blood pressure, also called hypertension, is when the force of blood against the artery walls is too high, usually 140/90 or above, and it raises the risk of heart attack and stroke, often without symptoms.

rows.q: What is asthma?
rows.text: Asthma is a long-term condition in which the airways in the lungs become inflamed and narrow, causing wheezing, coughing, tightness in the chest and shortness of breath.

rows.q: Why does ice float on water?
rows.text: Ice floats on water because it is less dense than liquid water.

rows.q: Why do we have time zones?
